paper.title: Neural network-based nodal structures optimization for interacting fermionic systems
paper.authors: William Freitas, B. Abreu, S. A. Vitiello

results.system_description: 2D quantum dot: 6 electrons (3 up, 3 down) in a harmonic trap, omega = 0.28 (Hartree units), Coulomb repulsion
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational Monte Carlo integration with the optimized parameters, run after the optimization (Sec. Results).
results.notes: Hamiltonian Eq. (2): the dimensionless form with 1/(2 lambda^2) r^2 and lambda = E_H*/(hbar omega) = 1/0.28 is the Hartree-unit dot with omega = 0.28 (effective Hartree, GaAs). N_up = N_down = 3 is not stated; inferred from the closed-shell comparison with the DMC of the same table. The energy lies below the DMC values of the same table, as the paper reports; the DMC, PIMC, CCSD and IM-SRG rows are quoted.
